text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Cough! Hack!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, quit making a scene over
everything. It was
just a little cough.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Anyway, about my training...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's getting old. I can practically go
through the
whole menu on muscle
memory alone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If our goal is to win the Kikuka Sho, then
she'll
have to really level up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Speee! Let's do some sprints on the
beach
together!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Tickezo! You scared me! Um, are you
sure you
want to run with me?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Super sure!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: If we train together, we can draw out each other's strength to the max, and I'll be able to run faster than everrr!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: C'mon, let's do this! Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that makes so much sense, Tickezo!
Okay, I'm
on board! Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, that overflowing enthusiasm makes
me sick.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: But... I dunno...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin goes silent after that. I
think I know
what she's trying to say.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure training with someone would
help break
the monotony she's feeling.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Like you'd be able to find anyone.
choice_data_list: トレーニング相手、探してこようか

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You saw what Ticket was getting up to,
and
Hayahide said she wanted to train
on her own this
summer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Don't come crying to me if people scoff
at you
when you ask them to train with a
pipsqueak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not only did Narita Taishin do great at
the
Satsuki Sho and Japanese Derby,
she's one of the
top three racers running
the Classics.
choice_data_list: もう君にそんなこと言う子はいないよ
もう貴方にそんなこと言う子はいないよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her how there's no one in Tracen
Academy
who doubts her skills.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Do whatever you want...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, I run around the beach, trying
to find a
potential training partner or
two for Narita
Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you want us to do strength
training by
whacking watermelons?
Don't tell me we have to
do this with our
bare hands, haha.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Of course not! We can use a bat!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, that sounds a whole lot like a
regular ol'
summertime game than actual
training.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Omigosh, Rice, you're awesome! You
brought so
many tires!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah! I pulled a whole bunch over
because,
well, I want to work on being
more gutsy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Okay, which one to pick...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Watermelon-splitting? How
exactly is that
train—
choice_data_list: スイカ割りでパワートレーニング
タイヤ引きで根性トレーニング

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, Taishin! I'll start us off, so I'm
counting
on you to guide me while I'm
blindfolded!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm the guide?! Talk about getting thrown into the deep end...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Who asked you?!
choice_data_list: ゲームキャラを操作すると思って！

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
There! The blindfold's on, so let's get
started!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Urk!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Take two steps to the right! Then three
steps
forward... No, that's too far!
Backtrack a step and
a half!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: And then... ATTACK!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Taishin! Your
instructions
were really easy to follow!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Uh... Sure thing.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Nature's prepped the watermelon
over there
for us to eat. Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Geez, the watermelon's bashed to
smithereens...
Wouldn't it have been
better just to cut it
normally?)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chomp.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, strange, isn't it? The
watermelon's a little
wonky-looking, but
it tastes better than normal.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hm...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin ends up having a
relatively nice
summer.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A-are you sure you want to join us,
Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I might end up c-cursing you with bad
luck... if we
train together...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What kind of logic is that? Anyway, I'm
the one
asking if I can train with you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: So, I guess... Could I?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh! S-sure! We'd love to have you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hup!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The training goes well, and Narita
Taishin reaps
the benefits.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, lookie! They're selling shaved ice!
We trained
hard, so let's reward
ourselves with dessert!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, shaved ice! I wonder if they have
apple
flavor?

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Ah, shucks. I'm sorry! Business was
booming
today, and I'm plum out of ice!
I'm waiting on a
new delivery to come
now.
choice_data_list: よし、3人分買ってくるか！
よし、3人分買ってくるよ！

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Oops, it's the phone. Hello? What?!
You're really
close, but there's been an
accident?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! Not good! Everyone's waiting for
the
ice—we'd better go help!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wait... Are you serious?!

text_block_list.name: Truck Driver
text_block_list.text:
Dang it, I can't believe I ran off into the

shoulder...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, gosh... Wh-what do we do? If only I
hadn't
wanted shaved ice!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Okie-dokie! All we've gotta do is pick
up your
truck, right? We can do it!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah! Um, w-we've got this!

text_block_list.name: Truck Driver
text_block_list.text:
What?! This thing's loaded with cargo! I
know
you're all Umamusume, but still...

text_block_list.name: Truck Driver
text_block_list.text:
You're all so petite! I can't be asking you
to pick
up a truck.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Tch...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Out of our way. Urara, Rice—let's do
this.

text_block_list.name: Truck Driver
text_block_list.text: What?! Wait, you'll hurt yourse—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hup... YAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Truck Driver
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa! Unbelievable!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to their combined efforts, they
manage to
get some well-earned shaved
ice.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: You were so cool, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah! You were so cool... and bold!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wh-what's gotten into you two?
